wiki.title: John Fonfara
wiki.extract: John W. Fonfara (born December 1, 1955) is an American politician serving in the Connecticut State Senate since 1997, representing the 1st district, comprising parts of Hartford and Wethersfield. A member of the Democratic Party, he is serving in his 13th-term in the State Senate, and is the chair of the Finance, Revenue & Bonding Committee.
